about: Copy to farm_hosts.json (not in git) and list the GPU machines that render this film: python3 tools/farm_ssh.py check, then setup, then render <tag>. rate = dollars an hour (your provider's price page; 0 for your own machines). Budget: the film's total on this farm. after = a command that stops the machines when the render ends (they cost money while they are on, rendering or not). Remove the examples you do not use.
